comments.body: Flag registered in staging; bootstrap field wired. Ready for experiment design to set the 10% cohort.

content.text: Flag registered in staging; bootstrap field wired. Ready for experiment design to set the 10% cohort.

The compact board density experiment needs a server-evaluated flag so we can ramp 0→50% of workspaces without a client deploy. Hard-coding the density class in the board shell blocks controlled rollout and clean kill-switch.

Add feature flag board_density_compact via the existing flag service, evaluate it in the dashboard bootstrap payload as density: 'compact' | 'comfortable', and gate the CSS density data-attribute on that value. Default off for all workspaces.

Complete when flag admin can target by workspace id and plan tier, client respects the bootstrap field without a local override, and kill-switch to off restores comfortable density within one refresh.

Add feature flag board_density_compact via the existing flag service, evaluate it in the dashboard bootstrap payload as density: 'compact' | 'comfortable', and gate the CSS density data-attribute on that value. Default off for all workspaces.
Complete when flag admin can target by workspace id and plan tier, client respects the bootstrap field without a local override, and kill-switch to off restores comfortable density within one refresh.
